svg.aria-label: A terminal showing the kaizen loop. First, a release-notes skill fails to find its changelog, runs kaizen capture --check, which finds no duplicate, and writes one suggestion file. In any later session the SessionStart hook prints kaizen: 1 open. Then /kaizen lists the backlog grouped by the file to fix, edits that skill, commits with a Kaizen-Suggestion trailer and closes the item with the commit sha, after which the hook prints kaizen: 0 open.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
